dimensions.assessment: Affects telecommunications applicants seeking rights-of-way on public lands and federal agency personnel processing Form 299s.
dimensions.evidence: provide applicants additional transparency with respect to the status of the applicable Form 299 for communications use authorization

dimensions.assessment: Mandates a plan for tracking applications and increasing transparency rather than changing underlying permitting laws.
dimensions.evidence: submit to the appropriate congressional committees a plan containing a description of... the process by which the Assistant Secretary proposes to... track

dimensions.assessment: The source does not mention any funding amounts or economic costs associated with developing the tracking plan.
Requires a single administrative plan to be delivered to specific congressional committees within 180 days.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 180 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Assistant Secretary shall submit... a plan

dimensions.assessment: Fulfills a one-time reporting requirement regarding administrative tracking processes.

importance_detail.rationale: This bill requires the National Telecommunications and Information Administration to submit a plan to Congress for tracking federal broadband deployment applications (Form 299s) on public and forest lands. It is a planning and reporting mandate.
